content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TNSFFCC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 29-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TNSFFCC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TNSFFCC Contractual Personnel posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the TNSFFCC Contractual Personnel posts is 29 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Contractual Personnel at TNSFFCC?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for Contractual Personnel posts announced by the Tamil Nadu State Forest Fire Control Centre.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Contractual Personnel positions at TNSFFCC is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the GIS Expert post?
faq.answer: For the GIS Expert post, candidates need a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Geography, Geo informatics, Remote Sensing & Forestry, or a related discipline. A Post Graduate Diploma/Diploma in GIS & Remote Sensing with a relevant Bachelor's Degree is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for a Wireless Operator at TNSFFCC?
faq.answer: The Wireless Operator position offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 22,020/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for TNSFFCC Contractual Personnel recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial shortlisting of applications based on educational qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for TNSFFCC recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the provided information, no application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions advertised are on a Contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the highest salary offered for any post?
faq.answer: The highest salary offered is Rs. 70,000/- per month (Consolidated) for the System Analyst/ IT Manager post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The direct download link for the official notification PDF can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
